title: Seu perfil
summary: Seu perfil, one screen (MZ, 3 Nov 2026): the name and photo people who chat with the user see (the Matrix profile), the @, the public profile (ADR 0041) with its name, bio and social handles (ADR 0228), and two facts about the account: Membro desde and the internal ID. One Salvar saves every part. It replaces the three screens Nome e foto, Nome de usuário and Perfil público.

handle.description: The text in the field, without the fixed @.

problem.description: socialHandleProblem with the user's own @: social_invalid, social_reserved or null.

name.description: The name field. Starts as Client.displayName.

avatarUrl.description: Client.avatarUrl, or a local file URL of a newly picked photo.

nameProblem.description: empty: bipe_public_profile_name_empty. tooLong: bipe_public_profile_name_too_long with nameMaxLength. reserved: bipe_app_profile_name_reserved. lookalikeEmoji: bipe_warning_name_lookalike_emoji (security rule 8). Save is off unless none.

handle.description: MyProfile.handle. Without it the switch is off and locked: bipe_public_profile_needs_handle.

publicName.description: MyProfile.name. A profile never saved starts with the Matrix display name.

of.description: One registries/profiles.json socials entry: its name, the handle the user typed (MyProfile.socials[id], empty when none) and its socialHandleProblem (none, invalid or reserved, with the user's own @).

socials.description: One field per network, in registry order (ADR 0228).

publicProblem.description: From profileProblem: bipe_public_profile_name_empty, bipe_public_profile_name_too_long (nameMaxLength), bipe_app_profile_name_reserved, bipe_public_profile_bio_too_long (bioMaxLength), bipe_public_profile_bio_too_many_lines (bioMaxLines). Save is off unless none. A social field with a problem shows bipe_public_profile_social_invalid (argument: the network name) or bipe_public_profile_social_reserved under that field, and Save is off.

memberSince.description: MyProfile.member_since, shown as bipe_profile_member_since with the date (medium style, the phone's locale). The row is hidden when absent.

userId.description: The Matrix user ID of the account (@localpart:server), shown as bipe_profile_internal_id in monospaced type. A tap copies it and shows bipe_app_copied.

phase.description: loading: GET /v1/me/profile runs; the name and photo show at once. failed: bipe_app_save_error, or the problem the server returned (ProfileProblem); the fields keep their values. After a save without error the screen closes.

publicLink.description: https://bipe.chat/@handle (BipeProfileLink), shown at the top of the socials section with bipe_app_profile_link as its label, in monospaced type. Only while the saved MyProfile.enabled is true and handle is set, so the link always opens a page.

appear.effect: Reads Client.displayName and Client.avatarUrl (Client.cachedAvatarUrl first, to show at once). Then GET /v1/me/profile and syncPhoto. A public profile never saved starts with the Matrix display name.

setName.effect: Updates name and nameProblem with the local rules (see notes).

choosePhoto.effect: Opens the system photo picker, then a square crop.

openHandle.effect: The @ row: with a handle, opens profile-link; without one, opens handle-pick. After handle-pick the screen reads GET /v1/me/profile again.

setPublicEnabled.effect: Updates publicEnabled. The public fields show only while it is on.

setSocial.effect: Updates that field and its problem (socialHandleProblem with the user's own @).

copyLink.effect: Copies publicLink to the clipboard and shows bipe_app_copied.

shareLink.effect: Opens the system share sheet with publicLink.

copyUserId.effect: Copies userId to the clipboard and shows bipe_app_copied.

save.effect: Sends only what changed. Matrix: Client.setDisplayName with the trimmed name; Client.uploadAvatar with a JPEG for a new photo, or Client.removeAvatar. Public profile, when publicEnabled, publicName, bio or socials changed: PUT /v1/me/profile with enabled, name, bio (trimmed) and socials (every field after socialHandleClean; an empty field is left out). Then syncPhoto after a photo change or a public profile save. Then the screen closes. Salvar is off while nothing changed or nameProblem, publicProblem or a social field has a problem.

syncPhoto.effect: Runs only when MyProfile.enabled. Client.avatarUrl absent and has_photo: DELETE /v1/me/profile/photo. Client.avatarUrl not equal to MyProfile.photo_source: Client.getMediaContent, square crop, JPEG (BipeProfilePhoto), PUT /v1/me/profile/photo?source=<mxc>. Else nothing. A failure shows nothing; the next run tries again.

notes: Opens from the profile row at the top of Você (spec voce), from the trust card name and photo steps, and from the photo ask (chat-list-prompt). The settings registry has no profile group since 3 Nov 2026.

Layout, top to bottom (MZ, 3 Nov 2026: one screen, not three sub-screens): (1) the photo, 96 pt, with bipe_public_profile_photo_change and bipe_public_profile_photo_remove, then the name field (bipe_profile_display_name, or bipe_company_name for a company) with bipe_profile_display_name_footer or the nameProblem text; (2) the @ row: bipe_settings_handle with @handle as the value, or bipe_handle_prompt_action when none; (3) the section titled bipe_settings_public_profile: the switch bipe_public_profile_toggle with bipe_public_profile_footer (without a handle: locked, with bipe_public_profile_needs_handle), and while on, the public name, the bio and the socials section; (4) a section with Membro desde and the internal ID, with bipe_profile_internal_id_footer. Salvar sits in the navigation bar (iOS) or the top bar (Android).
The internal ID is the full Matrix ID (MZ, 3 Nov 2026), for support. It is the one place in the app that shows it; every other screen shows names and @ only (ADR 0112).

Name rules: trimmed; not empty; at most nameMaxLength of registries/profiles.json; not a reserved name of registries/reserved-names.json after normalize() with the homoglyph map (exact match). Reference: profileProblem (name_empty, name_too_long, name_reserved) and normalize in tools/lib/registries.mjs; cases in test-vectors/normalization.json. Bipe logic: BipePublicProfileRules.profileProblem and NameNormalizer (BipeKit); BipePublicProfile.kt and NameNormalizer.kt (libraries/bipe).

Matrix has no server check for reserved display names. The app check stops honest mistakes; other people's apps also show bipe_warning_reserved_name next to an unverified reserved name (person-profile).
Photo: the app crops it square and re-encodes it as JPEG before upload. Client.subscribeToOwnProfile keeps the screen right when another device changes the profile.
A company account (ADR 0132) edits the company name here too: the same fields, with bipe_company_name as the field label. The type comes from GET /v1/accounts/{userId}/type.

lookalikeEmoji (bipe#595): the name holds an entry of registries/profiles.json sealLookalikeEmoji, compared after removing U+FE0E and U+FE0F. Reference: sealLookalike in tools/lib/registries.mjs. Checked after reserved. Only the verified seal may sit beside a name; the check runs on the phone because Matrix has no server check for display names.

Name and bio are separate from the Matrix profile (ADR 0041): changing them does not change profile-edit, and the other way round. The first time, the app fills the name from Client.displayName. The photo is not separate (ADR 0041, amended 2 Nov 2026): the screen shows the profile photo, and the user changes it in profile-edit.

Rules: registries/profiles.json (nameMaxLength 50, bioMaxLength 160, bioMaxLines 4, photoMaxBytes, photoMaxPixels) and the reserved names, by profileProblem in tools/lib/registries.mjs. The server is the authority and returns the same ProfileProblem ids. Bipe logic: BipePublicProfileRules and BipeProfilePhoto.jpegData (BipeKit BipePublicProfile.swift); BipePublicProfile.kt (libraries/bipe).

Photo: the API keeps a copy of the Matrix avatar, because the web page cannot read Matrix media. JPEG only, at most photoMaxPixels on each side and photoMaxBytes. The app re-encodes; the server strips every metadata segment. syncPhoto runs on appear and save here and after a photo change in profile-edit, so an avatar changed in another client reaches the public page the next time the user opens either screen.
Without a handle: the switch is locked, bipe_public_profile_needs_handle shows with bipe_handle_prompt_action, which opens handle-pick.
Turning it off hides the profile at once: GET /v1/profiles/{handle} answers 404, the same as for an unknown handle.

Social accounts (ADR 0228): a section titled bipe_public_profile_socials after the bio: first publicLink with bipe_app_copy (copyLink) and bipe_app_share (shareLink), then one text field per registries/profiles.json socials entry labelled with its name and a fixed @ before the text, then bipe_public_profile_socials_footer. The field takes a handle, never a URL: no URL keyboard, no autocorrect, no autocapitalisation. Bipe logic: BipeSocialHandles (BipeKit, libraries/bipe), the port of socialHandleClean, socialHandleProblem and socialUrl, checked by test-vectors/social-handles.json.

Socials alignment (after an MZ report, 3 Nov 2026): every social field starts at the same x. iOS puts the network names in one column of fixed width (96 pt, scaled with Dynamic Type), then the fixed @ and the field; a field problem sits under the field, indented to the same x. Android uses full-width outlined fields with the network name as the label and @ as the prefix, the same width as the name and bio fields.
